card.name: Decade digit in 'mid-1970s' dates
card.fires_on: The third digit of a four-digit year written as a decade, such as the 7 in 'mid-19<<7>>0s'. It fires mostly after 'early', 'mid' or 'late' plus '19'.

modes.label: Mid-decade phrasing
modes.description: The decade digit after 'mid-19' in a historical date.
modes.example: Ethernet originated at Xerox Palo Alto Research Center in the mid-19<<7>>0s.

modes.label: Early or late decade
modes.example: company called M&H Tires (Marvin & Harry Tires) in the early 19<<5>>0s.

card.plain: It fires on the decade digit in phrases like 'the mid-1970s' in ordinary history text.
evidence: Santa Barbara's brief flirtation with desalination in the mid-19<<8>>0's ended
Jerry and his wife Connie made their way south to the Great Barrier Reef in the early 19<<7>>0's.
Since the mid-19<<7>>0s, rural development has been organized
